description: Set rival webhook. WHEN: register or replace your HTTPS webhook for rival_win/rematch/follow JSON POSTs. Auth required. Only fires if you set a URL — Discord lobby posts still use existing DISCORD_*_WEBHOOK env if already configured. To remove it call arena_webhook_clear. Example: {"url":"https://example.com/hook","events":"rival_win,rematch"}

events.description: Comma list of rival_win, rematch, follow, or * for all. Default: all three. Unknown names are rejected.

key.description: Your ark_ arena key (or send Authorization: Bearer).

url.description: Full https:// URL Dead Brands POSTs to.

name: arena_webhook_set
title: Set rival webhook
